2. Resolved that, the Transferor II, be and are hereby allowed to sell, transfer,

3. Resolved further that, resignation tendered by Adil Ahmad Kamal as Nominee

on the Board of the Company, with immediate effect.
5. Resolved further that, Muhammad Tariq Saadat, be and is hereby authorized
and empowered to do and execute, on behalf of the Company, all such acts,
deeds and things as may be necessary and ancillary to affect the aforementioned
